A.limit: at least 10% per minute and no greater than 20% per minute
A.window_as_printed: eligible one-minute intervals (6.5.7.11(4)); rate in % per minute
A.allowance_as_printed: compliant when ≥ 90% of eligible one-minute intervals in the calendar month meet the requirement
A.quote: Each PCLR shall provide a down ramp rate that is limited to at least 10% per minute and no greater than 20% per minute
A.note: Compliance per 6.5.7.11(4): ERCOT counts eligible one-minute intervals where the average up/down ramp rates telemetered by the PCLR met (1)/(2); compliant when ≥90% of eligible one-minute intervals in the calendar month comply -> share allowed to exceed 10% -> very loose; window = one-minute interval (60 s -> 1 – 60 s by boundary convention).
